name: code-agent-workspace
description: 通过 Web 操作本地 Coding Agent 的应用
author: BryanHu

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:node
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:architecture && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run check:ci:host && pnpm run test:performance:browser
scripts.check:ci:host: pnpm run check:ci:quality && pnpm run test:performance:host
scripts.check:ci:quality: pnpm run audit:prod && pnpm run codex:schema:check && pnpm run protocol:rust:check && pnpm run release:version:check && pnpm run check && pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle:check && pnpm run package:check
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo check --workspace --locked && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.lint:architecture: depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.cjs apps/node-cli/src apps/web/src packages/client/src packages/engine-node/src packages/protocol/src packages/server/src packages/transport-http/src packages/transport-tauri/src
scripts.test:desktop-ipc: pnpm --filter @code-agent/desktop prepare:codex && pnpm --filter @code-agent/desktop exec tauri build --debug --features desktop-e2e --bundles app --config ../../tests/desktop-ipc/tauri.e2e.conf.json --ci --no-sign && wdio run ./tests/desktop-ipc/wdio.conf.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm run prepare:e2e-fixtures && playwright test
scripts.test:performance: pnpm run test:performance:host && pnpm run test:performance:browser
scripts.test:performance:browser: pnpm build && pnpm run prepare:e2e-fixtures && playwright test --config playwright.performance.config.ts
scripts.test:performance:host: pnpm run test:performance:node && pnpm run test:performance:rust
scripts.test:performance:node: pnpm run build:native:performance && node --expose-gc ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.performance.config.ts
